messages:
Alex M: heads up — saw a weird sampling delta on WS keepalive sampling this morning. console showed probe_sample_fraction dropped from ~5% -> 0.05% for a subset of tenants around 07:12 UTC
Priya S: hmm can you paste the query you used?
Alex M: query: `sum(rate(ws_keepalive_sampled[1m])) / sum(rate(ws_keepalive_total[1m]))` — ran across rolling 5m window, results attached
Alex M: screenshot: https://redwood-internal/snapshots/2026-03-21/sample-drop.png (internal only)
Dan K: that's the adaptive-sampling proto we rolled last week? possible rollout/backfill bug
Priya S: which rollout specifically? tuning/telemetry-v2?
Dan K: yes — we pushed telemetry-v2. It sets a conservative fallback: `sample_fraction = min(0.001, tenant_override)` when mem-pressure tag is unknown. If proxies fail to annotate mem-pressure, sampler clamps very low.
Taylor P: ops-bot shows proxy group eu-west-1/streaming had a rolling restart at 07:10 UTC (deploy-2026-03-21-07)
ops-bot: deploy notice — streaming-proxy v10.4.8 rolled at 07:09-07:14 UTC (canary -> 100%)
Alex M: so deploy + missing mem-pressure annotation = adaptive sampler set to extreme low, which explains dashboards/alerts undercounting and only a couple tenants tripping
Priya S: impact scope? any customer-facing incidents?
Alex M: internal SLO monitors alerted; two customers opened support tickets about increased reconnects and noisy telemetry.
SRE Oncall: looking at startup logs now. seeing sampler init path raising `KeyError: mem_pressure` for some proxies on boot.
Dan K: proposed fix: change fallback default from 0.001 -> 0.01 to reduce blast radius, and add defensive code to treat missing tag as "unknown" but not zero-out fraction.
Taylor P: agree. Also we should add an "effective_sample_fraction" column to the console per-tenant view and annotate last_config_source (deploy vs tenant override). UX ticket will help on-call triage faster.
Priya S: can we hotfix in prod? ops-bot, can we toggle a config to avoid zeroing fractions while we patch?
ops-bot: runbook action executed: sampler-default toggled to 0.01 for staging cluster at 07:38 UTC (actor=TaylorP).
Alex M: staging smoke looks good. quick check: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging-console.internal/api/metrics?tenant=acme | jq .sample_fraction` returned ~0.012
Dan K: I'll open a PR to change the hardcoded fallback, add tests for missing mem_pressure tag, and add a migration for old proxies.
Priya S: also please add an alerting rule: spike detection for sudden >5x drop in effective_sample_fraction relative to rolling baseline (5m vs 1h).
SRE Oncall: suggested rollout plan: canary 5% proxies for 30m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% if stable. will monitor reconnect and SLO graphs.
Dan K: noted. I'll include canary gates in the PR and a pre-merge checklist for QA.
Taylor P: I'll file infra-ux ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-1432 (console: add effective_sample_fraction, last_config_source tooltip, and a tiny sparkline)
Alex M: summary plan: 1) hotfix default -> 0.01 (canary 5%), 2) patch proxy startup to always annotate mem_pressure (or fall back to safe tag), 3) add unit tests for sampler, 4) console UX changes + dashboard alert, 5) postmortem if any customer impact worsens.
Priya S: assignments: Dan -> PR & tests, Taylor -> infra-ux ticket + mock, Alex -> staging smoke & monitor dashboards, SRE Oncall -> canary deploy and monitoring checklist.
Alex M: thanks all — will keep thread updated. posting follow-up if anything new shows up.
Taylor P: :thumbsup:
SRE Oncall: leaving note — will attach logs + alert history to incident channel after canary completes.
